name: Mindshield
author: voodoo573
description: Level 4 abjuration spell from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. The target has resistance to psychic damage and advantage on saving throws made to resist being charmed or frightened.
summary: 4th-level ward: psychic resistance and advantage on saves against charm and fear.
